todaysEvents.delta: Al Jazeera reported Iran launched a multi-front retaliation early Sep 2 on Jordan (13 missiles, 10 intercepted), Bahrain (drones on Sheikh Isa airbase), Kuwait (intercepted drones/missiles) and Iraq's Erbil (IRGC claims damage); no US casualties reported, the heaviest exchange in over a month.

todaysEvents.summary: US strikes on Iran kill about 12
todaysEvents.delta: Al Jazeera reported CENTCOM struck Iranian sites at Sirik, Konarak, Bandar Abbas, Jask, Asaluyeh, Ahvaz and Qeshm Island on Sep 1; a residential strike in Kuhestak during a wedding killed at least five, with roughly 12 dead overall.

Brent slipped to $95.45 (-0.19%) and WTI to $90.97 (-0.05%) on Sep 3 per Trading Economics as the prior US-Iran escalation spike partially consolidates; Qatar's LNG force majeure remains extended into early November.

scenarios.label: Base
scenarios.description: Iran and Oman advance a temporary corridor and mine-clearance framework; a signed, monitored reopening restores traffic and lowers Brent toward $75-85, while Qatar's force majeure keeps LNG availability constrained into early November.

scenarios.label: Stress
scenarios.description: The corridor remains provisional and traffic stays selective under Iranian fees, sanctions pressure and residual mine and attack risk; Brent holds $85-105 and JKM stays elevated while Qatar's force majeure runs into early November.

scenarios.label: Tail
scenarios.description: A widened multi-front exchange, a failed framework or renewed tanker attacks could close the southern lane again and spill into Bab el-Mandeb; Brent returns to $105-135+/bbl and JKM moves above $30/MMBtu.
